name: La Samanna

address.street: Baie Longue Terres Basses Saint Martin

insider_take: La Samanna sits on one of the Caribbean's most coveted stretches of sand - Baie Longue Beach - where French sophistication meets tropical paradise on the glamorous French side of St. Martin.
whats_special: This legendary resort occupies 55 acres of pristine beachfront along a mile-long crescent of white sand. Originally built as a private estate by James Frankel in 1973, La Samanna has hosted celebrities and royalty for decades. The property features authentic Moroccan architecture with hand-painted tiles imported directly from Morocco, creating an exotic oasis in the Caribbean.
pro_tip: Book a beachfront suite during whale watching season (January-April) when humpback whales migrate through the waters just offshore - you can spot them right from your terrace.
dont_miss: The sunset ritual at Baie Longue Beach is pure magic - the beach faces west for unobstructed Caribbean sunsets. Also, venture to nearby Marigot's Saturday morning market for authentic French pastries and local spices, just 10 minutes away in the charming capital of French St. Martin.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Baie Longue with pristine white sand
Luxurious French Riviera-style accommodations with elegant décor
Exceptional fine dining with Mediterranean and Caribbean cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Remote location requires transportation for exploring the island
